Tender Notice
Friday, 07 February 2025
1534 Hits
Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram is interested in purchasing the under Grocery Items and Vegetables & Fruits for Dietary Services. You are requested to send your lowest Tender as per terms and condition along with the respective sample against the items as mentioned below in a sealed envelope addressed to the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram, marked as ‘Tender for Vegetables & Fruits’. Tenders should reach us on or before 20
th
February, 2025 up to 04:00 PM.
The prices quoted by you should be F.O.R. Sevagram / Destination inclusive charges and taxes etc. Failing which the Tender might not be considered.
The Medical Superintendent reserves the right to reject any or all the Tenders without assigning any reasons.
Medical Superintendent
Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
